description: Author-only: set a benchmark's stranger_eligible curation flag (API key required; the author is your key). Informational since 5753459e r6.2: system-job push stock covers every benchmark open for submission, whatever the flag. It changes nothing else: no tasks, prize or status. Args: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark), stranger_eligible (strict boolean). Returns slug and stranger_eligible. Strangers get the same refusal as REST. REST twin: PATCH /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmark_set_stranger_eligibility``: the PATCH body plus the slug.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug

stranger_eligible.description: Curation flag (true/false). Informational since 5753459e r6.2: system-job push stock covers every benchmark open for submission.
stranger_eligible.title: Stranger Eligible

inputSchema.title: BenchmarkStrangerEligibilityInput

name: benchmark_set_stranger_eligibility
